facts.fact: Loi n° 2014-038 on the protection of personal data, adopted by the Assemblée nationale on 16 December 2014 and promulgated after Haute Cour Constitutionnelle decision of 7 January 2015, is dated 9 January 2015; the excerpt states no commencement date.
